_comment: ITCAS GPU sweep job spec. Jobs can be listed explicitly in jobs.separate and/or generated in jobs.group via cartesian products (methods x problems x difficulties, with quality only combined for method=itcas). Each expanded entry is ONE Slurm job: one (method, problem, difficulty[, quality]) over a seed range on a single GPU, executing n_concurrent seeds at a time until complete. Fields omitted in a job inherit from defaults. NOTE: budget/batch_size/n_init are problem+difficulty dependent and live in experiments_path (configs/experiments.json), NOT here.

group._comment: casd_llm baselines: Random, ECI, MOC-CAS (hard variant, the one abbreviated 'MOC-CAS' in itcas/reporting/method_labels.py), Straddle-then-Sample and BES-then-Sample at a 10% LSE-stage split. All are sequential (batch_size irrelevant to them; effective batch is 1). REQUIRES a running casd_llm evaluator server first -- see scripts/README.md 'CASD server (H100/H200)' -- and CASD_SERVER_URL exported in the shell that runs scripts/submit.sh (submit.sh forwards the full env via --export=ALL) so every array task can reach it.
casd_llm proposed method: itcas with the NDIG quality variant ('NDIG-B' in itcas/reporting/method_labels.py). Same server requirement as the group above.
